product.p1: Upload a chapter or the entire manuscript. Escritor.AI reads the text through the lens of the genre you declare — fantasy, mystery, young adult, romance — and returns precise annotations in the margin. Character coherence. Scene continuity. Rhythm. Voice.
product.p2: Suggestions only appear when you ask. The tool never replaces a paragraph of yours; at most, it proposes three paths and leaves the choice to who always had the choice: you.

features.lead: Jasper, QuillBot, Clarice.ai — all excellent for marketing copy. None made for Brazilian literary fiction. Escritor.AI is the first.

items.body: Fantasy has different rules than romance, which has different rules than young adult. Escritor.AI adjusts its lens based on your work's declared genre — not an SEO template.
Choose from 3 to 6 reader profiles — beginner, genre reader, critical reading. See where each one stays hooked, where they disengage, and which scene closes the book for the first time.

No generating the next paragraph for you. No homogenizing your style. Escritor.AI learns your authorial voice from chapters you've already written, and uses that as the benchmark for its own suggestions.
